title: Submodule generated by a subset
statement:
Let $R$ be a ring, let $M$ be a left $R$-module, and let $S\subseteq M$. An $R$-submodule is an additive subgroup closed under the action of every scalar in $R$. The *span* (or submodule generated by $S$) is
$$
\operatorname{span}_R(S)=\bigcap_{N\subseteq M\text{ an }R\text{-submodule},\ S\subseteq N}N.
$$
Thus it is the smallest $R$-submodule of $M$ containing $S$. This definition applies to $M=R^{\mathbf Z_{\geq0}}$ with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication; for commutative $R$, these are the coefficient sequences of formal power series [def-weil-formal-power-series].
